title: Implement canonical state migration and adoption baseline
description: Execution controller for the canonical state/migration batch under epic-session15-fleet-evolution. This batch defines and implements the first migration-safe canonical state/adoption path: capability-aware state shape, migration receipts, dual-read/single-write behavior, and framework-version adoption markers. It should begin only after implementation-canonical-runtime-baseline-v1 is accepted, because it builds on the canonical wakeup/closeout/state surface established there.
non_goals: Do not perform fleet rollout in this batch
Do not rewrite README.md or framework/docs/llms-full.md in this batch
Do not implement post-evolution skills or sharded lug storage in this batch
Do not silently remove legacy compatibility without an explicit dual-read strategy

must_be_sequential: 1. Review goal-state design, capability-registry draft, fleet audit, and current runtime-baseline lug before editing.
2. Define canonical migration/adoption contract: framework_version separation, migration receipt shape, capability adoption markers, and dual-read/single-write rules.
3. Update state template and live state expectations so canonical sections are primary and migration metadata is explicit.
4. Update wakeup/closeout guidance where needed so migration/adoption behavior is recoverable and replay-safe.
5. Update migration guidance/documentation used by implementers so current repo tensions are addressed by the canonical model rather than BRIEF/Manifest-era assumptions.
6. Update this lug with findings, verification, and remaining rollout prerequisites.

Targeted consistency checks across template and live state files after edits

later_batches: Docs rewrite batch for README.md and framework/docs/llms-full.md
